title: Resumed/continued sessions never replay prior conversation onto the screen at startup
observed: After 'kiln --continue' resumes a session seeded by a prior '-p "add tests for the parser"' turn, the welcome screen shows a completely empty transcript (qa/runs/c1/iterm-dark/startup-continue-resumes-120x40/01-continue-resumed.txt rows 5-37 are blank) — neither the prior user prompt 'add tests for the parser' nor its reply 'Hello from faux.' appear anywhere on screen.
expected: docs/kiln-design-handoff and this scenario's own framing ('the prior turn's own text is expected to replay into the transcript') call for a resumed session's existing conversation to be redrawn on startup, the way replayTranscript() redraws it after a verbosity toggle or resize.
design_ref: internal/tui/app.go's replayTranscript (~line 1982) is only invoked via msgReplayTranscript, which is sent from Ctrl+O toggle, fullscreen resize and a couple of other in-session events (app.go:457,614,986,1970) — never from RunInteractive's startup path in internal/cli/tui.go. A resumed session's FindEntries() output is never committed to the bridge at startup; only agent.ResumeIncomplete (internal/agent/session.go:261) runs there, and it only re-drives a stalled *incomplete* operation, not a normal completed prior turn. Grepped the whole internal/tui and internal/cli packages for any 'isNew'/'IsNew' concept gating an initial replay: none exists.
